newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finland signs nuclear test ban treaty.
newsitem.headline: Finland signs nuclear test ban treaty.

text.p: Finland said on Tuesday it had signed the Comprehensive Nuclear Test Ban Treaty adopted by the United Nations General Assembly earlier this month.

In a statement, Foreign Minister Tarja Halonen called the treaty "an historic achievement", adding that Finland hoped it would enter force as soon as possible and that Finland intended to ratify it quickly and support it in all respects.

"Finland has striven for a ban on all nuclear test explosions for decades. Now this goal has been reached," she said. Finland would participate in an international monitoring system for treaty verification, she added.
